summary: Three churches: St. Ambrose, St. James and St. John the Evangelist. The Mass Schedule and Confession boxes are identical in all five bulletins read, and First Friday Adoration at St. Ambrose is printed in the Adoration box. The Perpetual Adoration Chapel at 123 Whittington Road is Adoration only (locked, door code, no Mass), so its Holy Hours are excluded. No open questions.

slots.rationale: R22: held at the Perpetual Adoration Chapel, 123 Whittington Rd, the former St. James Convent. Settled as an exclusion (no-public-mass): the chapel is for Adoration only, kept locked 24/7 with the door code from the parish office, and has no Mass, so it is not a church row. Its holy hours are not shown as Adoration at St. Ambrose or St. James (data/dioceses/rochester/excluded/perpetual-adoration-chapel-rochester.md).
